describe: The outputs of the first and only run of the registered rule, fixed as the baseline that RFC-004 replays. Replaying run.py on the pinned inputs at the pinned commit must reproduce positions_*.csv and report.json byte for byte; a second run on 2026-11-22 did. report.md is rendered from report.json by report.py.
replay_note: code_commit holds the runner and the arithmetic. Replay from replay_checkout: it has the same runner and the final registration. The registration could not be amended in the commit it pins, so at code_commit it is the earlier text, and a run from there writes a different registration hash into report.json. A replay from replay_checkout on 2026-11-22, rendered with report.py as first frozen, matched every output byte for byte; report.md was then re-rendered to make the group counts add up.
open_items: The raw market inputs exist only on the machine that ran the baseline; see the snapshot manifest. A durable copy is needed before another machine can replay it.
